Commands:
  opencode completion          Completion
  opencode acp                 ACP server
  opencode mcp                 MCP configuration
  opencode [project]           Interactive TUI [default]
  opencode attach <url>        Attach
  opencode run [message..]     Noninteractive run
  opencode debug               Diagnostics
  opencode providers           Providers [aliases: auth]
  opencode agent               Agents
  opencode upgrade [target]    Upgrade
  opencode uninstall           Uninstall
  opencode serve               Headless server
  opencode web                 Web server
  opencode models [provider]   Models
  opencode stats               Statistics
  opencode export [sessionID]  Export
  opencode import <file>       Import
  opencode github              GitHub
  opencode pr <number>         Pull request
  opencode session             Sessions
  opencode plugin <module>     Plugins [aliases: plug]
  opencode db                  Database
  opencode future-headless     Synthetic command [aliases: future-alias, another-alias]

Positionals:
  project  Directory

Options:
  -p, --prompt  Initial prompt
